hook: Year-end renewal quiz: can you get *3/3*?
title: Year-end renewal quiz: can you get *3/3*?

questions.q: Your insurance renewed. Does the client's copy of your COI update too?
options: Only if someone sends the new one
questions.why: A COI is a snapshot. They keep the old one until you send a new one.

questions.q: Your business license expires Dec 31. When do you start the renewal?
questions.why: Forms, fees, proof of insurance, holiday office hours. Give it room.

questions.q: The renewal notice went to an employee who left in March. Who reads it?
questions.why: Send renewal notices to a shared inbox, not one person.
